name: Baseline Five Numbered Clauses
input_characteristics: Standard 5 sequential clauses with clear numbering
notes: All 5 clauses uniquely aligned with verified full-text boundaries.

name: Repeated Prefix with Distinct Headings
input_characteristics: Identical 100+ character introductory preamble across clauses
notes: Sequential monotonic offset tracking resolved each clause uniquely.

name: Identical Boilerplate Clauses With Distinct Section Numbers
input_characteristics: Identical boilerplate text at sections 2 and 4
notes: Section numbers included in previews disambiguated duplicate bodies.

name: Long Clause Exceeding 5000 Characters
input_characteristics: Clause with 9951 characters of continuous text
notes: Full 9951 characters extracted without truncation or memory leakage.

name: Multiline Text with Sub-clauses
input_characteristics: Indented list items (a)-(c) with blank lines
notes: Line ending invariant matching preserved internal newlines cleanly.

name: Nested Numbering Hierarchy
notes: Sub-clause boundary collision prevented by exact prefix token.

name: Mixed Line Endings (CRLF / LF)
input_characteristics: Mixed Windows CRLF and Unix LF in source document
notes: findOccurrencesForToken adapted line breaks without offset drift.

name: Whitespace Variability
input_characteristics: Erratic indentation; tabs; multiple spaces; trailing whitespace
notes: Irregular whitespace parsed without boundary distortion.

name: Unicode and Legal Symbol Preservation
notes: Special characters and multi-byte UTF-8 preserved without mojibake.

name: Literal Ellipsis Inside Text (<100 Chars)
input_characteristics: Clause with literal ... inside sentence text (<100 chars)
notes: extractSearchToken did not strip literal ellipsis from short clauses.

name: Heading Token Reuse
input_characteristics: Identical GENERAL PROVISIONS heading repeated across sections
notes: Repeated non-unique headings safely dropped to preview; body clauses verified.

name: Short Clauses (<100 Chars)
notes: Short clauses without backend truncation marks aligned to exact byte boundary.

name: Non-Unique Substring Embedded in Prior Clause
input_characteristics: Clause 1 preview appears inside Clause 0 body as citation
notes: Monotonic offset tracking prevented backward search jumping into Clause 0.

name: Missing Match Desynchronization
input_characteristics: Clause preview absent from source text entirely
notes: Missing clause dropped to PREVIEW_ONLY_UNMATCHED without inventing text.

name: Boundary Ambiguity Fallback
input_characteristics: Subsequent boundary token cannot be verified in remaining text
notes: Unverified subsequent boundary triggered safe PREVIEW_ONLY_AMBIGUOUS.

name: Async Race / Document ID Mismatch Guard
input_characteristics: Active document ID does not match clause doc_id
notes: Document ID mismatch detected; prevented stale result text overwriting newer contract.

name: Missing Raw Contract Text in Memory
input_characteristics: Raw contract text is empty/null in React memory
notes: Empty contract memory safely returns PREVIEW_ONLY_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
